part.title: Before You Start
part.subtitle: How this guide works
intro: This part explains how to use the route, the game rules that matter for trophies, and the one habit that protects the platinum: staying honourable and keeping manual saves.
Nothing here is missable. Read it once, tick the steps, then start a new game.
Expect roughly 240-300 hours for the full platinum: about 50-60 hours of story, a long single-player clean-up, then Red Dead Online. The online part depends heavily on how you earn XP.

steps.title: Learn how the route works
how: Work top to bottom. Every step sits where it should be done; you never need to scroll back.
Tick each step when it's done. Mission steps list their gold-medal objectives underneath.
Long goals (collectibles, challenges, animals) live in trackers. A 'session' step tells you when to open a tracker and what to do in it.
Use the missables filter to see only steps with a cut-off. Each shows the mission after which it is lost.
A 'warning' step always comes just before a point-of-no-return mission. Don't start that mission until every item in the warning is ticked.
Text marked as a spoiler stays hidden until you tap reveal.

steps.title: Know the game rules that affect trophies
how: Story mode has no difficulty setting, so no trophy depends on difficulty.
Never enter a cheat code. Cheats disable saving and trophy progress.
Red Dead Redemption 2 is a PS4 game. On PS5 it runs through backward compatibility and uses the same PS4 trophy list.
There is no chapter select. Anything you miss in a chapter needs an older save or a new playthrough.
One playthrough is enough if you follow the warnings.
Completed story missions can be replayed after the story from Pause > Progress > Story to earn gold medals you missed. Replays use basic gear and no tonics, so they are harder.
Replaying an optional honor mission from the Story menu does NOT count towards Lending a Hand. Those must be done during the story.

steps.title: Set up a manual save habit
how: Make a manual save at the start of every chapter.
Make a manual save before every story mission on your first playthrough. All gold objectives for a mission must be met in one run, and checkpoint restarts reset the counters.
Keep a separate save before each point-of-no-return mission. The route reminds you with a warning step.
Save before any robbery or crime spree, so you can reload if it goes wrong or costs too much Honor.
steps.tip: Rotate between several save slots so an autosave never overwrites the save you'd need to go back to.

steps.title: Understand gold medals
how: Gold Rush needs gold medals in 70 of the 104 story missions that have them, so 34 can be skipped.
Try for gold on your first run, but don't restart a mission endlessly. Missed ones can be replayed after the story.
Timed objectives include cutscenes. Skip cutscenes to save time.
'No health items' objectives only ban health items. Dead Eye items are allowed.
Restart from the checkpoint as soon as you fail an objective.
steps.unverified: Sources count gold-medal missions differently: PowerPyx says 104, GTABase says 105. The 70 needed for the trophy is the same either way.

steps.title: Stay honourable for the whole story
how: Keep Arthur's Honor on the good (white) side from the very start.
You need at least Honor level 4 of 8 by Chapter 6, or one of the optional honor missions will not start and Lending a Hand is lost.
Greet people, help strangers you meet on the road, and hogtie rather than kill when you can.
Don't rob or kill random people. If you do something dishonourable by accident, reload.
Catching and releasing fish, and handing in bounties alive, are quick ways to raise Honor.
Leave Extreme Personality (maximum Honor) for Chapter 6 or later. The top Honor level is locked until late in the story.
steps.unverified: Guides describe the Chapter 6 requirement as 'level 4 of 8', 'halfway into the white' or just 'high honor'. These mean the same thing, but aim higher to be safe.

steps.title: Know the four missable trophies
how: Lending a Hand: every optional honor mission in Chapters 2, 3, 4 and 6. Each set is lost when its chapter ends.
Friends With Benefits: one companion activity in each of the Chapter 2, 3 and 4 camps.
Give to the Poor: donate $250 to the camp tithing box before Chapter 4 ends.
Errand Boy: deliver 5 item requests to gang members before Chapter 4 ends.
The route puts each of these well before its deadline.
steps.unverified: One guide (GamerGuides) also treats Breaking and Entering as missable, because homesteads can be lost. The route does it in Chapter 2 to be safe.

steps.title: Plan your time
how: Stage 1, story (about 50-60 hours): handle the missables, do every optional honor mission, stay honourable, try for gold medals and start challenges.
Stage 2, after the story: collectibles, all 90 challenges, graves, stranger missions and gold-medal replays.
Stage 3: study and skin the animals for Zoologist and Skin Deep.
Stage 4, Red Dead Online to rank 50. It needs PlayStation Plus and can be done at any time.
steps.unverified: Red Dead Online servers were reported as working in late September 2026, with no shutdown announced. Check again before relying on the online trophies.
